newsitem.title: UK: BBC, Flextech in pay TV venture.
newsitem.headline: BBC, Flextech in pay TV venture.

text.p: The British Broadcasting Corporation is about to announce a joint venture with Flextech Plc to provide five new pay-television channels, the Independent newspaper said.
The paper said the BBC is expected to announce this to the stock market on Monday.
Flextech would contribute 22 million pounds ($35.2 million) as equity in the venture while its parent, TCI Communications of the U.S. would guarantee loan facilities of up to 118 million stg.
Pearson, due to announce its trading statement on Monday, will take a small stake in Flextech as part of the pay television venture, the Independent said.
The venture will translate into a cash flow of of 500 million pounds for the BBC over the next 10 years, the paper added.
